blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— Classes at all levels in Mamburao, Occidental Mindoro, were cancelled Wednesday following a magnitude 5 earthquake struck the municipality, according to a local government announcement. Mamburao officials said the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) recommended the class cancellation. “We are expecting aftershocks,” said Mamburao Mayor Glicerio S. Almero, in a public post, explaining that authorities would first need to complete inspections of schools in the municipality.
